home.title: MediLens
home.disclaimer: MediLens helps you understand your own medical records. Use it alongside your doctor's advice.

tips.title: Tips for a clear photo
tips.light: Use a bright place with even light.
tips.flat: Put the page flat and hold the phone straight above it.
tips.frame: Keep the whole page in view, with all four corners visible.
tips.glare: Avoid glare and shadows; skip the flash on glossy paper.
tips.privacy: Cover other people's names or details before you take the photo.

retake.not_a_document: We couldn't see a document page. Place the whole page in view and retake the photo.
